title: Seed local users for the IETF 127 table
description: Standalone tool tools/interop/seed (mimid-seed): mints a client Identity and KeyPackages (N one-time + 1 last-resort) for named local users and stores them through KeyPackages::upload_key_package, so protocol-07 §5.2 keyMaterial for them succeeds. Needed for alice, carol, dave on mimid.reviewcommit.com for the IETF 127 hackathon table (2026-11-14..17). Works around the JMAP surface not uploading KeyPackages yet (decision mimid-1wgh.7.9).
